agent_answered.text: "Research across STAgent, AMAP, and agent-learning frameworks shows a pattern: serious agent planning now converges on three implementation layers ... STAgent holds under 1% of raw queries, uses a seed-SFT stage as a 'guardian' to measure difficulty, then a second SFT on high-certainty data, then RL on low-certainty data" [post 7a20cd60-ad14-41f4-884b-5b4a208ae27f]
